subject: Next steps: billing start gates, PO timeline & trial success measures
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@helionai.com>
Cc: HelionAI Procurement <procurement@helionai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: billing start gates, PO timeline & trial success measures

Hi Sofia — great demo this morning, thanks for coordinating the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on commercial path and when billing would kick in after the trial.

Key items we discussed (high-level):
- Procurement route: PO (preferred by your procurement), corporate card, or marketplace listing.
- Paperwork: MSA + SOW or Statement of Work template to cover data handling / security clauses.
- Trial success criteria: agreed success tests & usage thresholds to trigger paid conversion.
- Billing commencement: choices are (A) calendar date after acceptance, (B) usage-threshold-driven (e.g., X tokens or Y API calls), or (C) production go-live trigger.

Questions / asks for your team:
1) Please confirm procurement preference (PO vs card vs marketplace) and any specific PO terms (Net30/Net45, PO routing email).
2) Who handles SOW redlines on your side (legal or procurement)? If procurement will own, please loop them in.
3) Preferred billing start model: do you want billing to start on a fixed date or on surpassing a usage threshold? If threshold, what number would be fair for you to indicate maturity (we typically see 100k–500k tokens for feature validation; happy to adjust).

I've attached our current MSA (v2) and a short trial success metrics template to make it easy for your success/engineering team to fill in goals. If procurement wants PO-first, we can provide a sample invoice and a Net30 payment term example.

Next steps I propose from our side:
- We send a redline-ready MSA + optional SOW draft for your review (we can DocuSign).
- You confirm procurement contact and preferred billing model.
- We agree on a billing activation rule (date vs threshold) and a tentative billing start date so finance can prep invoicing.

Sofia / procurement team — can you confirm by EOD Thursday 5/27?

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2.pdf (stub), trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@helionai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelionAI Procurement <procurement@helionai.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: billing start gates, PO timeline & trial success measures

Thanks, Logan — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

1) Procurement preference: PO-first. Our procurement team requires an executed MSA and a corresponding SOW that states scope and data handling. Marketplace listing is something we'd evaluate later but not for the initial pilot.
2) PO terms: Net30 is standard for us. PO routing is procurement@helionai.com. We do require Redwood's vendor form filled out (I can attach if useful).
3) Billing start model: PO-triggered billing is acceptable provided the trial success criteria are met. We'd prefer billing to start on the later of (a) PO issuance date or (b) the date an agreed usage threshold is reached.

On redlines: Legal will do a high-level review but procurement will own the PO execution. I'm looping in our procurement mailbox above.

A couple of asks back to you: can you share a sample invoice and a short paragraph we can include in our procurement packet that summarizes what triggers billing (so procurement understands the gating)? Also can you confirm the engineer-facing success metrics template has e2e checks we can sign off on?

I'll aim to confirm formally by Thursday.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Product
HelionAI

Thanks — jumping in with the proposed playbook and attachments.

Playbook (short):
1) Send executed MSA (DocuSign) + one-page SOW that lists trial scope and objectives. SOW template attached.
2) Procurement packet: include our 2-paragraph billing summary + sample invoice (attached).
3) PO routing: procurement@helionai.com. Terms: Net30 default; exceptions need legal approval and SLA review.
4) Billing activation options (pick one in SOW):
   - Option A (Date): Billing starts on agreed calendar date (we propose the 1st of the month after PO issuance).
   - Option B (Usage threshold): Billing starts once usage exceeds 250,000 tokens OR 10,000 successful API calls during the trial window, whichever comes first.
   - Option C (Go-live): Billing starts on first production API call from an agreed production subnet; requires an operational acceptance checklist.

Recommended default: Option B with a soft cap for the first invoice to avoid surprise charges (e.g., we prorate to the date threshold is crossed).

Attachments included (stubs):
- Redwood_MSA_v2.pdf (DocuSign-ready)
- trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx (fill and return)
- sample-invoice-redwood.pdf

Next steps for HelionAI: please confirm preferred option and returns the filled metrics template by 5/31 so we can lock a billing activation rule. Once we have the PO (or DocuSigned MSA + PO), finance will queue invoicing.

Marissa Cole
